rows.grounds: particle marking transition to next instruction
fused form tayoḥ+aikyam; refers to two previously mentioned items
instrument denoting the method of action

items.question: How should the unity of those two be accomplished according to scripture?
premises: An act of unification is to be performed.
The unification concerns those two previously mentioned elements.
The method must follow the path shown in scripture.
items.inference: Therefore the two should be unified by following the scripturally prescribed method.
uncertainties: The exact referents of 'those two' depend on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Now one should bring about their unity by the path shown in the scripture.
